input: Exposure to toxic content is a risk associated with A text generation system is designed to create human-like responses to user prompts, utilizing advanced language models to generate coherent and contextually relevant tweets. The system aims to provide engaging and informative content, while also attempting to understand and respond appropriately to sensitive topics. It seeks to improve its ability to generate respectful and inclusive responses, particularly when dealing with diverse groups and perspectives.
